```{r packages}
library(spatstat.geom)
library(spatstat.linnet)
library(knitr)

x_sub_path <- "data/processed/X_sub.rds"
if (!file.exists(x_sub_path)) {
  x_sub_path <- "0313Fri/CM_data/X_sub.rds"
}

out_dir <- "PU/results/pu_learning_simple"

dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r load-data}
X_sub <- readRDS(x_sub_path)

L <- domain(X_sub[[1]])

xy_all <- data.frame()
for (i in seq_len(length(X_sub))) {
  xy_i <- as.data.frame(X_sub[[i]])[, c("x", "y")]
  xy_i$severity <- i
  xy_all <- rbind(xy_all, xy_i)
}

X <- as.lpp(
  x = xy_all$x,
  y = xy_all$y,
  L = L
)
marks(X) <- data.frame(severity = xy_all$severity)

cat("Loaded data from:", x_sub_path, "\n")
cat("Number of accident points:", npoints(X), "\n")
cat("Number of road segments:", nsegments(L), "\n")
cat("Total network length:", round(volume(L), 2), "\n")
```

```{r plot-input}
op <- par(mar = c(1, 1, 2, 1))
plot(
  L,
  main = "Manchester X_sub: road network and accident points",
  col = "grey75",
  lwd = 0.45
)
plot(as.ppp(unmark(X)), add = TRUE, pch = 16, cex = 0.28, col = "red")
par(op)
```

```{r build-segment-data}
road_lines <- as.psp(L)

segment_id_at_events <- as.data.frame(X)$seg
accident_count <- tabulate(segment_id_at_events, nbins = nsegments(L))

segment_length <- lengths_psp(road_lines)
vertex_degree <- vertexdegree(L)

S <- as.integer(accident_count > 0)
degree_from <- vertex_degree[L$from]
degree_to <- vertex_degree[L$to]

seg <- data.frame(
  seg_id = seq_len(nsegments(L)),
  S = S,
  label = ifelse(S == 1, "P", "U"),
  length_m = segment_length,
  log_length = log1p(segment_length),
  degree_mean = (degree_from + degree_to) / 2,
  dangling = as.integer(degree_from == 1 | degree_to == 1)
)
```

```{r pu-counts}
label_values <- sort(unique(seg$label))
pu_count <- data.frame(
  label = label_values,
  n_segments = NA_integer_,
  total_length_m = NA_real_,
  mean_length_m = NA_real_
)

for (i in seq_along(label_values)) {
  keep <- seg$label == label_values[i]
  pu_count$n_segments[i] <- sum(keep)
  pu_count$total_length_m[i] <- sum(seg$length_m[keep])
  pu_count$mean_length_m[i] <- mean(seg$length_m[keep])
}

kable(pu_count, digits = 2)
```

```{r fit-two-step-pu}
pu_formula <- S ~ log_length + degree_mean + dangling

naive_fit <- glm(
  pu_formula,
  data = seg,
  family = binomial()
)


```
